name: Álvaro I of Kongo
contribution: A Manikongo, or king of Kongo, from 1568 to 1587, and the founder of the Kwilu dynasty.

checks.lead: Álvaro I Nimi a Lukeni lua Mvemba was a Manikongo (Mwene Kongo), or king of Kongo, from 1568 to 1587, and the founder of the Kwilu dynasty.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
